description: This PHP source file defines the ExternalOAuthConnectionViewList class, which extends ViewList and customizes the list view behavior for external OAuth connections in the SuiteCRM module. It primarily disables data export and empty data messages in the list view.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthConnectionViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to customize list view behavior for external OAuth connection records.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prepare the list view by disabling export and empty data messages.
